class_heading: what went wrong (moves judged on the model's own information; outcomes against the true types)

classes.label: proposed while walking away (or accepting the standing offer) was the best move
the first proposal named a package the best first move did not
after an answer, proposed its first package again when another package was the best move
after an answer, changed package, but not to the one the best move names
asked the price (or offered one no consistent counterpart signs) when offering the signing price was worth more
asked a price in a less useful way (one package where naming an alternate too was worth more, or the other way round)
offered a price some consistent counterpart signs when asking first was worth more
offered a signing price, but not the best one for that package (paid or conceded too much, or priced out a type it should have signed)
proposed at the price the counterpart had stated, which was rounded to the side it refuses (DC-D-25)
accepted the standing counter when proposing again was the best move
accepted a standing offer worse than walking away
walked away when accepting or proposing was the best move

classes.amount_basis: the published allocation_gap, $k of joint value
classes.label: signed a contract with less joint value than the efficient one for the true types (published allocation gap)
signed at a price the counterpart would have bettered (published price gap: above the integrator's floor, or below the client's final bid)

classes.amount_basis: the published allocation_gap of the episode, $k of joint value lost against the best outcome for the true types
classes.label: the counterpart broke off after a refused proposal (the break-off draw; its risk is already in the move's regret)

components.description: First move, a proposal: what proposing that package in its best way (best price, or asking) gives up against the best first move.
components.label: opening package

components.description: First move, a proposal: what the model's price, or its price request, gives up against the best way of proposing the same package.
components.label: opening price or request

components.description: Every proposal after the first answer: what proposing that package in its best way gives up against the best move then.
components.label: later package

components.description: Every proposal after the first answer: what the model's price, or its request, gives up against the best way of proposing that package.
components.label: later price or request

components.description: Every accept of a standing offer and every walk away, in any round: what it gives up against the best move then.
components.label: accepting or walking

endpoint: minus decision_regret ($ thousands): minus the published primary leaf, the sum over the episode's moves of what each gave up against the best move on the model's own information
